name: Conveyor Belt Slippage
description: The main conveyor belt for Line 1 is experiencing intermittent slippage, causing items to be misaligned for robotic arms.
initial_impact: Misalignment defects on Line 1 will increase by 20%.

cascading_effects.effect: The packaging robot will fail more often due to misaligned products, causing a bottleneck.
cascading_effects.impact_description: The packaging unit is immediately downstream from the belt.

cascading_effects.effect: Fewer packages will be ready for shipment, potentially delaying orders.
cascading_effects.impact_description: The impact on shipping schedules will be noticeable after about an hour of the bottleneck.
